sources.content: # .cursorrules for Sablewick. Sablewick is a web dashboard that shows the layer cache of container build servers. The frontend is TypeScript with React 18 and lives in `web/`; the API server is in `server/` and runs on Node.js 20. Install with `pnpm install` at the repository root. Start both parts with `pnpm dev`; the frontend serves on port 5173 and the API on port 4100. Tests run with `pnpm test`, which uses Vitest.

Rules for edits. Use function components only; no class components. Fetch API data through the hooks in `web/src/api/`, never with fetch calls inside components. Styles use CSS modules, one `.module.css` file per component. Server routes must validate input with zod schemas kept in `server/schemas/`. Do not change `pnpm-lock.yaml` unless the task adds or removes a dependency. Keep each pull request to one feature. Name React components in PascalCase and start hook names with use.

claims.text: The Sablewick API server runs on Node.js 18.
Sablewick server routes validate input with zod schemas.
The Sablewick frontend serves on port 5173 during development.
Sablewick components may fetch API data with fetch calls inside the component.
